create_lfm2vl_image_processor: create an Lfm2VlImageProcessor instance for LFM2-VL vision-language models with SigLip2 NaFlex support
process_mm_data_async: process multimodal image and text data asynchronously for LFM2-VL model inference
build_multimodal_special_tokens: build MultimodalSpecialTokens with image token and image token ID for LFM2-VL processing
register_naflex_modalities: register NaFlex-specific processor outputs like pixel_attention_mask and spatial_shapes as IMAGE modality
load_mm_data: load multimodal data from image data and input text using the base processor flow
